citations.assessment: The father and grandfather are explicitly named in the tefillin-straps episode. The evaluation of the grandfather as a sage is additional.
The exact son is named in the scarf and thread incident.
Rabbi Horkenos reads the whole passage at Kefar Itam.
Horkenos tries to remove his father’s tefillin on Sabbath eve and is rebuked.
The exact parallel is in halakhah 7 under this division. Retain Heilprin’s printed numbering.
